editorial.method: Human word-for-word comparison against the chosen edition required

notes: Three eight-line stanzas plus the D.S. chorus ("Stayed upon Jehovah"), placed after stanza 1. Syllable hyphens rejoined; punctuation as printed, including no comma after "victorious" and the comma in "Like a river, glorious". Book is undated; 1924 rests on its latest internal copyright notice (1924) and Hymnary.org's dating of this 428-hymn edition.
